findingsForArt.subject: dufferin-terrace-toboggan-run
findingsForArt.finding: Even with the kiosk replaced by a plain shelter, this repeating tile still named Terrasse Dufferin, Quebec City for me. The cues were the green Gothic-pattern cast-iron railing, the multi-globe lamps and the X-braced slide tower together. Priming by the branch name contributed.
